package domain

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestBuildLearningActionTargetEvidencePolicyMatrix(t *testing.T) {
	target := LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.error-wrapping", Version: "v1"}
	closedAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	tests := []struct {
		name     string
		class    LearningEvidenceClass
		outcome  LearningActionOutcome
		support  TeacherSupportContext
		wantKind LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind
	}{
		{name: "failed knowledge", class: LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck, outcome: LearningActionFailed, support: TeacherSupportIndependent, wantKind: EvidenceFailedKnowledgeCheck},
		{name: "assisted understanding", class: LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck, outcome: LearningActionPassed, support: TeacherSupportGuided, wantKind: EvidenceAssistedUnderstanding},
		{name: "independent understanding", class: LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck, outcome: LearningActionPassed, support: TeacherSupportIndependent, wantKind: EvidenceIndependentUnderstanding},
		{name: "failed application", class: LearningEvidenceApplication, outcome: LearningActionFailed, support: TeacherSupportGuided, wantKind: EvidenceFailedApplication},
		{name: "assisted application", class: LearningEvidenceApplication, outcome: LearningActionPassed, support: TeacherSupportGuided, wantKind: EvidenceAssistedApplication},
		{name: "independent application", class: LearningEvidenceApplication, outcome: LearningActionPassed, support: TeacherSupportIndependent, wantKind: EvidenceIndependentApplication},
	}
	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			action := masteryTestAction(target, closedAt)
			action.EvidenceClass = test.class
			action.Outcome = test.outcome
			assistance := masteryTestAssistance(action, test.support)
			got, err := BuildLearningActionTargetEvidence(action, assistance)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("BuildLearningActionTargetEvidence returned error: %v", err)
			}
			if len(got) != 1 || got[0].Kind != test.wantKind || got[0].OccurredAt != closedAt {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected target evidence: %+v", got)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestBuildLearningActionTargetEvidenceRejectsMismatchedTargets(t *testing.T) {
	closedAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	action := masteryTestAction(LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"}, closedAt)
	assistance := masteryTestAssistance(action, TeacherSupportIndependent)
	assistance.Observations[0].Target.Key = "go.interfaces"
	if _, err := BuildLearningActionTargetEvidence(action, assistance); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected mismatched target set to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestBuildLearningActionTargetEvidenceKeepsLegacyActionAssistanceOnly(t *testing.T) {
	closedAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	action := masteryTestAction(LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"}, closedAt)
	action.EvidenceClass = ""
	assistance := masteryTestAssistance(action, TeacherSupportIndependent)
	got, err := BuildLearningActionTargetEvidence(action, assistance)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("legacy action returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if len(got) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("legacy action created objective evidence: %+v", got)
	}
}

func TestReduceStudentTargetMasteryStateThresholds(t *testing.T) {
	target := LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap", Version: "v1"}
	base := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	tests := []struct {
		name     string
		evidence []LearningActionTargetEvidence
		want     TargetMasteryState
	}{
		{
			name: "failed knowledge is exposed",
			evidence: []LearningActionTargetEvidence{
				masteryEvidence("action-1", "task-1", target, EvidenceFailedKnowledgeCheck, LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck, base),
			},
			want: TargetMasteryExposed,
		},
		{
			name: "knowledge success is understood",
			evidence: []LearningActionTargetEvidence{
				masteryEvidence("action-1", "task-1", target, EvidenceAssistedUnderstanding, LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck, base),
			},
			want: TargetMasteryUnderstood,
		},
		{
			name: "failed application is practiced",
			evidence: []LearningActionTargetEvidence{
				masteryEvidence("action-1", "task-1", target, EvidenceFailedApplication, LearningEvidenceApplication, base),
			},
			want: TargetMasteryPracticed,
		},
		{
			name: "one independent application is applied",
			evidence: []LearningActionTargetEvidence{
				masteryEvidence("action-1", "task-1", target, EvidenceIndependentApplication, LearningEvidenceApplication, base),
			},
			want: TargetMasteryApplied,
		},
		{
			name: "three independent applications across tasks is mastered",
			evidence: []LearningActionTargetEvidence{
				masteryEvidence("action-1", "task-1", target, EvidenceIndependentApplication, LearningEvidenceApplication, base),
				masteryEvidence("action-2", "task-1", target, EvidenceIndependentApplication, LearningEvidenceApplication, base.Add(time.Hour)),
				masteryEvidence("action-3", "task-2", target, EvidenceIndependentApplication, LearningEvidenceApplication, base.Add(2*time.Hour)),
			},
			want: TargetMasteryMastered,
		},
		{
			name: "one task cannot establish mastery",
			evidence: []LearningActionTargetEvidence{
				masteryEvidence("action-1", "task-1", target, EvidenceIndependentApplication, LearningEvidenceApplication, base),
				masteryEvidence("action-2", "task-1", target, EvidenceIndependentApplication, LearningEvidenceApplication, base.Add(time.Hour)),
				masteryEvidence("action-3", "task-1", target, EvidenceIndependentApplication, LearningEvidenceApplication, base.Add(2*time.Hour)),
			},
			want: TargetMasteryApplied,
		},
	}
	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			got, err := ReduceStudentTargetMastery(test.evidence)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("ReduceStudentTargetMastery returned error: %v", err)
			}
			if got.State != test.want {
				t.Fatalf("state=%s, want %s", got.State, test.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestReduceStudentTargetMasteryScoresAndCounters(t *testing.T) {
	target := LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"}
	base := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	evidence := []LearningActionTargetEvidence{
		masteryEvidence("action-1", "task-1", target, EvidenceIndependentApplication, LearningEvidenceApplication, base),
		masteryEvidence("action-2", "task-2", target, EvidenceAssistedApplication, LearningEvidenceApplication, base.Add(time.Hour)),
		masteryEvidence("action-3", "task-3", target, EvidenceFailedApplication, LearningEvidenceApplication, base.Add(2*time.Hour)),
	}
	got, err := ReduceStudentTargetMastery(evidence)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ReduceStudentTargetMastery returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if got.MasteryScore != 0.5 || got.Confidence != 0.6 {
		t.Fatalf("score=%v confidence=%v, want 0.5 and 0.6", got.MasteryScore, got.Confidence)
	}
	if got.IndependentSuccessCount != 1 || got.AssistedSuccessCount != 1 || got.FailureCount != 1 || got.EvidenceCount != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected counters: %+v", got)
	}
	if got.LastPracticedAt == nil || *got.LastPracticedAt != base.Add(2*time.Hour) || got.LastFailedAt == nil || *got.LastFailedAt != base.Add(2*time.Hour) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected timestamps: %+v", got)
	}
}

func masteryTestAction(target LearningTargetRef, closedAt time.Time) StudentLearningAction {
	return StudentLearningAction{
		ID:                   "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentTaskAnswerID:  "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		StudentID:            "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskID:               "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		ContextType:          LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:            "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		LearningTargets:      []LearningTargetRef{target},
		EvidenceClass:        LearningEvidenceApplication,
		Outcome:              LearningActionPassed,
		OutcomePolicyVersion: MasteryPolicyVersion,
		OpenedAt:             closedAt.Add(-time.Hour),
		ClosedAt:             &closedAt,
	}
}

func masteryTestAssistance(action StudentLearningAction, support TeacherSupportContext) TeacherAssistance {
	kind := TeacherObservationIndependentContext
	if support == TeacherSupportGuided {
		kind = TeacherObservationGuidedContext
	}
	return TeacherAssistance{
		EventID:          "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		StudentID:        action.StudentID,
		CorrelationID:    action.ID,
		CausationID:      "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		LearningActionID: action.ID,
		ContextType:      action.ContextType,
		ContextID:        action.ContextID,
		SupportContext:   support,
		Observations: []TeacherAssistanceObservation{
			{Target: action.LearningTargets[0], Kind: kind},
		},
		PolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1",
		OccurredAt:    action.ClosedAt.Add(time.Minute),
	}
}

func masteryEvidence(
	actionID string,
	taskID string,
	target LearningTargetRef,
	kind LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind,
	class LearningEvidenceClass,
	occurredAt time.Time,
) LearningActionTargetEvidence {
	outcome := LearningActionPassed
	support := TeacherSupportIndependent
	switch kind {
	case EvidenceFailedKnowledgeCheck, EvidenceFailedApplication:
		outcome = LearningActionFailed
	case EvidenceAssistedUnderstanding, EvidenceAssistedApplication:
		support = TeacherSupportGuided
	}
	return LearningActionTargetEvidence{
		LearningActionID:     actionID,
		StudentID:            "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskID:               taskID,
		Target:               target,
		EvidenceClass:        class,
		Outcome:              outcome,
		SupportContext:       support,
		Kind:                 kind,
		TeacherPolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1",
		MasteryPolicyVersion: MasteryPolicyVersion,
		OccurredAt:           occurredAt,
	}
}
